items.title: Helpdesk Using Domino IQ RAG By Adam Foster and Doug Tait
items.summary: Discover how AI can transform the way complex systems are supported and maintained. In this session, you’ll learn how to build an intelligent support bot using Domino IQ RAG that empowers both help desk operatives and end users to find accurate answers faster. We’ll explore real-world challenges in managing technical systems and show how AI can reduce downtime, improve resolution times, and enhance user confidence. Through practical examples, you’ll see how to design, train, and deploy an effective support assistant. Whether you’re in IT, operations, or digital transformation, this session will give you actionable insights you can apply immediately. Join us to see how AI can turn complexity into clarity and support into a strategic advantage. Takeaways 1 Domino IQ works nicely with RAG integration 2 Domino IQ is quite easy to integrate with existing databases 3 AI can be added to existing infrastructure without sacrificing security
